It also fires on a relative pronoun who/that that picks up such a noun. It reads the subject already in place and does not depend on the verb that follows. It stays low (below about a quarter of max) on inanimate tool or object subjects (device, method, machine, tool, weather), on plural subjects (inventions, women, they), on first- and second-person subjects (I, we, you), and on the same nouns in object position.
